// Fixed-step integration parameters: the fixed step FixedDeltaTime is divided
// into Substeps sub-integrations; VelocityIterations and PositionIterations
// are constraint solver iteration counts; MaxStepsPerFrame caps catch-up
// stepping when the render frame runs long.
type TimeStepSettings
    implements IValue
{
    FixedDeltaTime: Duration;
    Substeps: Integer;
    VelocityIterations: Integer;
    PositionIterations: Integer;
    MaxStepsPerFrame: Integer;
}
